limitations_and_notes: All 30 outputs were re-read directly; the runner and archived summary were not imported or used as the source of the recomputation.
Strict think closure and post-boundary token slices are independently checked against generated IDs and runtime special IDs (151667/151668).
Final text is independently projected from full generated_text after </think> and special EOS text removal, then parsed with the frozen regex.
A local tokenizer asset is unavailable, so complete non-special token-ID-to-text decoding was not independently rerun. Token-list hashes and special-boundary indices are checked.
EOS ID 151645 is independently obtained from the historical model manifest; all observed normal completions terminate with it.
Local GPU/model weights are unavailable: runtime full weight SHA records were independently compared with the historical audit, but weights were not hashed again locally.

Ten paired inputs, two per hop, and one stochastic sample per input do not support a population accuracy or minimum-safe-budget claim. Three caps are repeated experiments on the same inputs, not 30 independent problem samples.
GPU snapshots bracket each run; they do not prove absence of transient contention or OOM inside an unrecorded interval. No OOM/error artifact or log evidence was observed.
status.json pending_runs=30 is a stale initialization field; COMPLETE and completed_runs=30 agree with all 30 validated shards.
